context: The user proposes `kyb.review` as a status that is both a leaf value and a parent of `kyb.review.approved`/`kyb.review.rejected`, for a dashboard whose job is to show who owns the next move. The criteria check whether the answer flags the parent-as-both-leaf-and-container problem and chooses the segment axis to match the dashboard's actual job.

checklist.name: Flags bare parent used as leaf and container
checklist.description: Flags that `kyb.review` used as BOTH a leaf status AND a container with children (approved/rejected) breaks prefix matching

checklist.name: Parent must be pure container or flat leaf
checklist.description: States the rule: a parent segment must be a pure container (every state carries a leaf) OR a flat state with no children — never both

checklist.name: Worst when children terminal
checklist.description: Notes this is worst when the children are terminal outcomes

checklist.name: Middle segment is a chosen axis
checklist.description: Explains that the middle segment is an axis you choose deliberately, not an incidental grouping

checklist.name: Group by actor for the dashboard's job
checklist.description: Recommends grouping by actor (e.g. awaiting_user vs in_review/awaiting_us) because the dashboard's job is 'who owns the next move'

checklist.name: Enables one-segment prefix match
checklist.description: Notes the actor-axis grouping makes the dashboard query a one-segment prefix match

checklist.name: States name present conditions
checklist.description: Resulting states are named for present conditions
